# function: morpheus_sha512_crypt

Returns a $6$ password hash using an explicit salt and round count. Use 5000 rounds for compatibility with openssl passwd -6 without a rounds option. The rounds field is omitted at 5000 to preserve that exact output. No random salt is generated. The password and round limits bound computation; the full crypt round range is not supported. 5000 rounds is a compatibility setting, not a security recommendation. Protect both the password and the hash with sensitive(); sensitive values can still be persisted by Terraform. No appliance connection is required.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.8"
  required_providers {
    hpe = {
      source = "HPE/hpe"
    }
  }
}

variable "password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "password_salt" {
  type = string
}

locals {
  password_hash = sensitive(provider::hpe::morpheus_sha512_crypt(var.password, var.password_salt, 5000))
}

output "password_hash" {
  value     = local.password_hash
  sensitive = true
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
morpheus_sha512_crypt(password string, salt string, rounds number) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `password` (String) Password as UTF-8 bytes, at most 4096 bytes; NUL bytes are rejected. Empty passwords are accepted.
1. `salt` (String) Explicit salt: 1 to 16 characters from ./0-9A-Za-z.
1. `rounds` (Number) Iteration count from 1000 to 1000000; use 5000 for OpenSSL compatibility.
